reasons: Position is safe: LTV 0.3843 is well below the corridor act level 0.7 and the 0.86 liquidation LTV, with a 55.32% price drop needed to liquidation; no reduce action is warranted.

The only fired screen on this market is ETH/USD staleness of 1203s vs 1200s max - 3 seconds over, answer still positive; this is marginal and should clear on the next feed update, so it does not justify acting.

leave_market is not justified: the backup market shows the identical stale ETH/USD feed and the demo market uses a team-set mock oracle, so there is no safer approved destination, and venue-status feeds report no open oracle or pool incidents.
Market conditions are healthy: utilization 0.5946 is below the 0.95 screen threshold, pool matches oracle (0.0% deviation), and borrow APR is 0.57%.

Base Denim upgrade is scheduled for 18:00 UTC today, roughly 8 hours away, with the status page expecting Mainnet to remain operational; re-evaluate if the ETH/USD feed remains stale or as the upgrade window approaches.

items.title: Testnet markets operating normally
items.text: Testnet markets operating normally | The live, backup and demo markets on Base Sepolia (deployments/testnet.json) accept supply and borrowing. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.

items.title: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed
items.text: Testnet markets re-supplied; executor redeployed | On 4 November the team's lender supply returned to the live and backup markets (13 USDC each) and the demo market (5,000 dUSDC) on Base Sepolia, and the executor moved to 0xA9bbabE6d75C5BA96CA095586284774c9D09D18b (deployments/testnet.json). All three markets accept supply and borrowing; the live market's public Uniswap 0.01% pool again holds the team's price band. No incident is open for their oracles or pools.
